gloss: person concerned; eligible person; applicable person

definitions.gloss: person concerned; eligible person; applicable person
definitions.explanation: a person who meets certain conditions, criteria, or qualifications and is therefore subject to a rule, benefit, or requirement

examples.japanese: {該当者|がいとうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}て→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Those who are eligible, please come forward.

examples.japanese: {該当者|がいとうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後日|ごじつ}→後日：12510_gojitsu⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Those who qualify will receive notification at a later date.

examples.japanese: ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{該当|がいとう}する→該当する：29179_gaitousuru⟧{該当者|がいとうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Since there were many eligible persons who met the conditions, it was decided by lottery.

notes:
Combines ⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧ (applicable, corresponding) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). A formal, administrative term frequently seen on forms, in official announcements, and in workplace communications. Often used when describing who is eligible for benefits, subject to regulations, or included in a particular category.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {該当者|がいとうしゃ}なし: no applicable person; nobody qualifies
- {該当者|がいとうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: there is someone who qualifies
- {該当者|がいとうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to select the eligible persons
- {該当者|がいとうしゃ}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: all persons concerned

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {対象者|たいしょうしゃ}: target person; subject — someone targeted by a program or action
- ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧: person involved; stakeholder — someone connected to a matter, broader than {該当者|がいとうしゃ}
- {有資格者|ゆうしかくしゃ}: qualified person — someone holding a specific certification or license
